answer_1.quote: We consider two main downstream tasks for evaluation: (i) translating English text to code-switched text (EN2CS) and (ii) translating code-switched text to English text (CS2EN).
answer_1.outputs: code-switched sentences and their English translations

answer_2.quote: We assess performance using the chrF++ and BLEU metrics introduced in sacreBLEU. ... we also provide partial COMET results in the appendix.

answer_4.quote: We engage native speakers for correction and validation. Annotators are presented with both the code-switched sentences and their English counterparts, and are tasked with aligning them accurately using the guidelines in Appendix B. They focus on adjusting the sentences to reflect authentic code-mixing patterns and relevant cultural contexts.
answer_4.guideline: Guidelines in Appendix B direct annotators to ensure authenticity, cultural relevance, and structural flexibility of the corrected code-switched sentences.
